panels.title: Status
panels.description: Up/down heartbeat (measurement vecserve, field alive). See the vecserve-down alert for the Discord page.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "tommybot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vecserve" and r._field == "alive")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Connections (current)
panels.description: In-flight /search and /geo requests at the last heartbeat.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "tommybot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vecserve" and r._field == "connections")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Oldest vector age
panels.description: Worst-case seconds since ANY vault's embeddings were last reindexed (max across vaults). The trickle reindexer runs ~every 15m, so a healthy system stays low.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "tommybot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vecserve" and r._field == "vector_age_s")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> max()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "tommybot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vecserve" and r._field == "errors")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Throughput (requests / interval)
panels.description: Search + geo requests handled per heartbeat tick (~30s).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "tommybot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vecserve" and r._field == "requests")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "tommybot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vecserve" and r._field == "avg_duration_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Vector age per vault
panels.description: Seconds since each vault's embeddings were last reindexed. One series per vault (tagged in the tommybot bucket).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "tommybot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vecserve" and r._field == "vector_age_s")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Task mirror — last successful sync
panels.description: Age of the last successful github_tasks_mirror run (obsidian-automations, hourly inside the asset-graph job). Feeds dev/Tasks/GitHub/, the RAG task corpus.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "github_tasks_mirror" and r._field == "success" and r._value == 1)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: (float(v: uint(v: now())) - float(v: uint(v: r._time))) / 1000000000.0}))

panels.title: Task corpus size
panels.description: Items in the mirror window at the last sync: open human/machine-task issues + 90-day closed + open proposal PRs.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "github_tasks_mirror" and r._field == "mirrored")
  |> last()

panels.title: Task mirror activity (per run)
panels.description: Notes written / deleted / content-hash-skipped each sync. A quiet mirror (all skipped) is healthy; sustained zero points means the job stopped.

options.content:
**vecserve** (`tommybot vecserve`) is the tailnet vector-retrieval server on the mini: it holds the embeddings DB + embedder so the Air's tommybot (and other tailnet consumers) can query search/geo over HTTP instead of syncing a DB copy. See `tommybot/vecserve.py` and the tommybot repo's `docs/embeddings.md` ("Serving retrieval over the tailnet").

- **Status** reflects the `alive=1` heartbeat vecserve writes every ~30s (`TOMMYBOT_METRICS_INTERVAL`) to this bucket. The **vecserve-down** alert (`grafana/provisioning/alerting/vecserve-down.yml`) pages Discord if no heartbeat lands for 5 minutes.
- **Throughput / Latency / Connections** are drained from the same heartbeat: request + error counts and mean latency since the previous tick, and the in-flight request count at tick time.
- **Vector age** is `now - last_reindex.ts` per vault, computed from the embeddings DB's own bookkeeping (`tommybot.embeddings.db_stats`) — no separate freshness check needed.
- Metrics are opt-in on the tommybot side (`TOMMYBOT_INFLUX_TOKEN` unset → silent no-op); until the mini is configured with a write token for this bucket, every panel here reads empty.

**Task mirror row** (`ops` bucket, `github_tasks_mirror` measurement): the `github_tasks_mirror` doit task (obsidian-automations) mirrors org task issues + proposal PRs into `dev/Tasks/GitHub/` hourly so the reindexer embeds them — the issues→mirror→embed→serve chain reads top-to-bottom on this dashboard. `success=0` points mark failed syncs (`gh` outage); no alert by design — the asset-graph staleness heartbeat pages if the whole job stops.
